_comment: SEC-40 ratchet baseline (OPS-AUDIT-REMEDIATION-LOW-W1). Per-file count of raw parseFloat/parseInt sites in venue adapters. A file may never EXCEED its number; lowering one (by converting to safeUpstreamNum) requires re-baselining downward, so the ratchet only tightens.
_shrunk_by: OPS-RATCHET-BASELINE-RETIRE-W1 (2026-08-04) — 195 -> 43. Every SIGNAL-PATH numeric field (price, funding, open interest, kline OHLC) across all 15 unconverted adapters now routes through safeUpstreamNum, matching the aster/edgex reference contract: candles with unparseable OHLC are DROPPED, an unparseable mark price THROWS so the 3-tier fallback fires, and funding/OI fall back to a safe neutral 0.
_what_remains: The 43 below are the DECLARED carve-out, not unexamined backlog: candle `volume` + `volume24h` (never reach a verdict), millisecond timestamps parsed with parseInt (`time`, `fundingTime`, `nextFundingTime`), and one cosmetic volume sort (okx.ts). They were deliberately left raw so the wave did not widen its blast radius past the fields that reach a verdict. Retirement path: OPS-ADAPTER-SAFENUM-SWEEP-W{NEXT} may convert them for uniformity, but nothing here is a signal-correctness risk, so that sweep is hygiene rather than debt.
